seats.name: Clinical Evidence & Safety Officer
seats.question: Is there a real knowledge gap, and can this be done without harming participants or patients?

seats.name: Methodologist & Biostatistician
seats.question: Does the design actually answer the question, with enough power and little enough bias to believe the result?

seats.name: Research Ethics & Regulatory Lead
seats.question: Will an ethics committee and the regulator approve this, and is participant data protected?

seats.name: Patient & Frontline Clinician Advocate
seats.question: Will patients enrol and stay, will clinicians cooperate, and does the outcome matter to them?

seats.name: Feasibility, Funding & Operations Lead
seats.question: Can this team finish it on this budget, data infrastructure, and timeline?

seats.name: Journal Editor & Peer Reviewer
seats.question: Is it novel, publishable, and ready for the target journal, and what will Reviewer 2 say?

seats.name: Health Economist & Payer Strategist
seats.question: Who pays, from which budget, and is it cost-effective compared with current practice?

seats.name: Health Informatics & AI Lead
seats.question: Is the data fit for purpose, is the model validated the right way, and will it integrate with clinical systems?

seats.name: Translational & Basic Scientist
seats.question: Is the mechanism plausible, is the preclinical or biomarker evidence solid, and is the lab work doable?

seats.name: The Outsider
seats.question: Reading this cold, with no medical background, what is confusing, overclaimed, or unconvincing?
